import pandas as pd
import re

# Create a DataFrame with inconsistent text data
data = {
    'name': ['  alice ', 'BOB', 'Charlie ', '  diana', 'EVE  '],
    'email': ['ALICE@EMAIL.COM', 'bob@email.com', 'CHARLIE@Email.Com', 'diana@email.com', 'eve@EMAIL.COM'],
    'phone': ['(555) 123-4567', '555.234.5678', '5553456789', '555-456-7890', '(555) 567 8901']
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Strip whitespace and title-case names
df['name'] = df['name'].str.strip().str.title()

# Lowercase all emails
df['email'] = df['email'].str.lower()

# Standardize phone format to (XXX) XXX-XXXX
def format_phone(phone):
    digits = re.sub(r'\D', '', phone)
    return f"({digits[:3]}) {digits[3:6]}-{digits[6:]}"

df['phone'] = df['phone'].apply(format_phone)

print(df)
